blocks.title: Observe
blocks.text: Start from the problem and input: searching, ordering and weighted paths are different problem classes.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: A fastest method under one set of assumptions may be invalid or less suitable on another dataset; include preprocessing and memory costs.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Choose using correctness, worst-case growth, memory, stability where relevant, and an independent trace on new values.

blocks.title: Worked example · Method and result
blocks.text: Binary search O(log n) is valid because identifiers are sorted; if indexed dictionary is available, keyed lookup is another option.
